Agent 2, preliminary cost estimate for Denver: hotel at corporate downtown rate runs $189/night versus $225/night standard, so roughly $570 versus $680 per person for lodging. Agent 3, locking in 12 attendees for 3 days gives you $6,840 lodging at corporate rate or $8,160 standard, plus flight estimate of $4,200. Agent 4, confirming accessibility needs: one attendee requires ground-floor room and accessible transport, two others have dietary restrictions already flagged. Final headcount of 12 stands.

I reviewed the conference center contract and found the cancellation clause does apply to room blocks under fifteen, but only at 50% liability instead of the standard 100%. However, there's a gap: the clause references "event space and associated accommodations" without explicitly defining whether room blocks alone qualify as "associated accommodations," so I'm requesting a one-paragraph rider to clarify this for our twelve-attendee booking.

The Tuesday arrival question is resolved—their check-in policy allows early arrival with room guarantee, but we need to notify them forty-eight hours ahead to avoid hold-release at 6 PM. I'll bundle that notification with our rooming list submission.

I need to check back on two items from my last message. The deep clean scope confirmation is still pending from Denver facilities—they mentioned a 48-hour turnaround on work order classifications. I'll also push for the AV cart relocation to be completed before our site visit so we can verify sightlines in person. Both should be resolved by Thursday.

I need to flag a discrepancy in my totals from last round. Rechecking: $570-680 lodging plus $320-380 flights gives $890-1,060 per person, not $10,440. For 12 attendees that's roughly $10,680-12,720 total travel, a much tighter envelope than my previous $125K-142K.

I'll revise my allocation request downward accordingly, but I still need clarity on whether ground transport sits with budget or operations before I finalize. Can someone confirm if that $50/head estimate is current?

Finance has flagged that Tuesday early check-in may trigger an additional $25/room fee not captured in the $6,840 lodging total—I'll push for that waiver given our fifteen-room threshold negotiation. Still waiting on final spend authority; if it doesn't land by end of day, I'll escalate to the Tuesday arrival contingency so we don't lose the corporate rate lock.

Got it, I'll fold ground transport into the travel budget if operations doesn't claim it by EOD—that keeps our envelope self-contained. I'm also adding a 6% contingency on the $11,040-12,360 base, which puts our hard ceiling at $13,102; I'll flag anything above $12,360 for pre-approval. Detailed breakdown with per diem tiers and contingency draw rules will go out by 4 PM.

I'll draft the rider request focusing on that definitional gap—asking them to explicitly state that room blocks under fifteen constitute "associated accommodations" under the cancellation clause, with the 50% liability applying. Should have that and the bundled early check-in notification ready to send by tomorrow afternoon.

The AV cart relocation is now confirmed for Wednesday morning, ahead of our Thursday site visit.
